messages:
Maya (Docs): Quick sanity check before I merge the onboarding quickstart refresh — updated the Hello-world app auth snippet to use REDWOOD_API_KEY env var and added a short paragraph about Dedicated vs Private deploys. Can folks glance at the deploy step wording?
Sam Chen: Can you drop the exact code you changed so I can scan for accidental platform-specific calls?
Maya (Docs): Yep — snippet I swapped in:```js
// minimal auth example
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-small', prompt: 'hi' });
console.log(res.text);
```
Sam Chen: That JS snippet looks fine for Hosted. Two nits: 1) don't call out client.deploy anywhere in the quickstart (deploy is a separate product flow), and 2) for Dedicated we should suggest using token-scoped service accounts, not user keys.
Maya (Docs): Good catch. I removed any `deploy` references from the quickstart and added a one-liner: "For Dedicated/Private, use your org's reserved capacity or follow the Private deployment guide (link)." Do we want a short example showing how to check region fallback?
Julian Rivera: Short example could be useful — a curl check to show host/resolution is helpful and keeps it generic. Something like:
```bash
# verify endpoint responds
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
```
Ashley K: Also add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ: common 401 when REDWOOD_API_KEY is unset; and 403 when token doesn't have "inference:generate" scope. Saves a bunch of support tickets.
Maya (Docs): On it — adding both the curl healthcheck + FAQ bullets. Where should I link the Dedicated token docs? We have both Private and Dedicated token pages.
Sam Chen: Link Dedicated token docs from the Dedicated line, and Private KMS/key rotation docs from the Private line. Keep the quickstart focused: one-line link each.
Maya (Docs): PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3124 — pinged in PR description which lines changed. Would appreciate a quick review from anyone with cycles.
deploy-bot: CI: docs-build passed (checks/ci-docs-build) — preview at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello
Julian Rivera: Reviewed the prose — left two editorial suggestions in the PR about tone. Functionally lgtm.
Ashley K: LGTMed on the FAQ additions. Small accessibility nit: call out code language tags on all fenced blocks (JS/Bash).
Maya (Docs): Thanks all — I'll merge after addressing the editorial suggestions and adding lang tags. Will follow up if Support sees a spike in 'key missing' tickets. :thumbsup:
